description: URBANopt is a simulation platform for district, campus and neighbourhood energy modelling, including thermal and electrical analysis, built on the DOE's open-source OpenStudio and EnergyPlus. It is a software development kit, requiring development or scripting for use: a set of open-source modules that software developers can use, customise or extend in their own tools, and that researchers can script into custom workflows. The project targets three uses: cost-effective integrated energy solutions for campuses and districts through multi-building scenarios, grid-interactive buildings with distributed energy resources and distribution systems, and next-generation district thermal systems such as community geothermal and waste heat recovery. NLR describes it as an advanced analytics platform for building locations, efficiency features, storage, aggregated grid services and district system performance. Coverage: generic. Access: open modules with getting-started guides and tutorial videos. Licence: open source, name not read. Caveats: it expects scripting skills and OpenStudio familiarity. Simulation uses: district energy, DER and grid-interaction scenario analysis. Related records: OpenStudio, EnergyPlus and the Modelica Buildings Library.
